title: Doorbell Ding Dong
blurb: Two tones, high then low, and somewhere a dog is already losing its mind. The classic residential ding-dong carries more narrative than almost any other domestic sound. Someone is here, unannounced. A decision has to be made about answering. On calls and streams that loading turns it into a prank, since people genuinely stand up and walk to a door that is not theirs. It also makes an excellent clean scene transition in edits. Original synthesis, free MP3 download, no delivery driver required.
origin: Original synthesis of the classic two-chime residential doorbell.
